title: Perp z-score
description: How unusual the perpetual's price is against its recent average, in standard deviations. Beyond two either way is rare.

z_1m.label: Z 1m
z_1m.description: Distance from the one-minute mean in standard deviations. Beyond plus or minus two is a stretched reading.

z_5m.label: Z 5m
z_5m.description: Distance from the five-minute mean in standard deviations. Slower to move than the one-minute read.

z_15m.label: Z 15m
z_15m.description: Distance from the fifteen-minute mean in standard deviations. The slow baseline behind the shorter reads.
